data.long_meaning: In Greek, Babara is derived from the Greek word 'baba,' which means 'god.' The suffix 'ara' means 'promise.' Therefore, Babara signifies 'God's promise.'. The name Babara carries the meaning “God's promise” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Babara usually hope their child will grow to embody god's promise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine protection and faith.
data.etymology: Babara belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's promise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Babara total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Babara carries a deep spiritual meaning for Christians. It's a reminder that no matter what challenges or hardships one may face, God is always with them and will keep His promise to provide and protect. It's a name that embodies trust and faith in God's promise.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Barbara: The name Barbara means "foreign, stranger" in Greek, but in Christian tradition it symbolizes the "stranger to the world" who is a dedicated follower of Christ. It also represents strength and endurance, as Saint Barbara is the patron saint of those subjected to harsh trials and persecutions.
